snapshots.title: shadcn-solid setup and coverage
snapshots.content:
Use the official installation guide to copy components and their Tailwind theme into a Solid project. Upstream examples import from @/registry/ui; adjust that alias to your copied components. These previews compile the pinned Tailwind v4 registry sources.

Verified preview coverage: Button, Dialog, Tabs. Other components and variants have not been mirrored.
